Marta: Heads-up: proposal to change SDK routing shape to support weighted routing. Current param `model: str` -> new nested `routing: {policy, model, weight?}`. Need thoughts on compatibility + console rollout UX.
Jamal: Wait, full breaking change? or can we accept both shapes server-side? :thinking:
Priya: We can be backwards compatible server-side for a while, but the SDKs probably need a major bump. Recommend deprecation warning for 2 releases then break. Also a small migration helper in the console.
Leo: Server runtime already accepts both shapes in the request layer (we added that for experiments). We can support the old `model` key and translate to `routing: {policy: "default", model: <old>}` for ~6 months. That buys SDK teams time.
Marta: Good. That matches my plan: soft-accept on server, SDKs warn at runtime, then hard error in 6 months. Need telemetry to measure adoption.
Priya: For telemetry, emit `sdk.routing_shape` event with `shape: old|new`, `sdk.language`, `sdk.version`. Add counts to the console migration panel.
DevEx Bot: I can add the event schema + sample ingestion code. Also propose the Python/TS examples for migration page.
Jamal: What about the user-visible UX? Customers with per-route routing should see a migration badge and an "Auto-migrate routes" button in Console. Also show an estimate of differences (e.g., "100 routes will switch to weighted routing with default weight=100").
Marta: Exactly. Also need an admin opt-out for enterprises during Private deployment.
Leo: Ops note: Dedicated pools must preserve exact routing semantics if customers had pinned models. Auto-migrate should be off by default for Dedicated/Private.
Priya: SDK change details: Python -> add `routing` kwarg, deprecate `model`. Example: 
```python
# old
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-1", prompt=prompt)
# new
resp = client.generate(routing={"policy": "weighted", "model": "redwood-1", "weight": 100}, prompt=prompt)
```
TS example too: 
```ts
// old
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt })
// new
const r = await client.generate({ routing: { policy: 'weighted', model: 'redwood-1', weight: 100 }, prompt })
```
Jamal: For the SDKs, can we auto-promote `model` -> `routing` in minor releases with a deprecation warning so existing code keeps working? Then major bump when we remove `model` arg.
Marta: Yes, do that. But make the warning highly visible and provide a codemod for TS/Python. DevEx: can you own the codemod?
DevEx Bot: I'll draft a jscodeshift + lib2to3 script and open a PR template for the SDK repos.
CI-Bot: Quick heads-up: python-sdk tests 12/142 failing on `test_generate_with_model_kwarg` after the dev branch reorg. Might be related — tagging @Marta.
Marta: Thanks. I'll look. If it's due to the new request shape mapping, we need to add tests that exercise both old/new shapes.
Leo: Rollout plan suggestion:
- Stage 1 (2 weeks): server accepts both shapes, SDKs add deprecation warnings (minor releases), console shows migration panel (dev mode).
- Stage 2 (month 1-3): telemetry collection + migration tooling matured, feature-flagged auto-migrate on hosted only.
- Stage 3 (month 3-6): major SDK release removing `model` param, server starts rejecting old shape unless account opt-in.
Jamal: Can we tie feature flags to SDK user-agent string? That would make canaries easier.
Priya: Yes — when we emit telemetry include UA and sdk.version. Console can show which orgs use new SDKs.
Marta: UX notes for Console: add a per-route preview of effective routing (showing weight distribution), a migration checklist, and an action to run a dry-run that simulates traffic distribution.
DevEx Bot: I'll draft examples and the migration checklist copy (`We recommend running the dry-run on low-traffic routes first`) and attach to PRs.
CI-Bot: I created a quick smoke pipeline job: `smoke-routing-migration`. Runs sandbox traffic replay and checks both shapes accepted.
Deploy-bot: Scheduling a canary rollout window tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC for the server-side mapping change. Please mark any blockers by EOD.
Priya: One more: docs & changelog entries. We should include code snippets and a migration timeline. DevEx: please add to the SDK release notes template.
Marta: Thanks everyone. Action items:
- DevEx: codemods + docs + telemetry schema (ASAP)
- SDK owners (Python/TS/Go): add deprecation warnings in next minor, add tests for both shapes
- Eng-platform (Leo): enable server-side translation and smoke pipeline
- Console (Priya + UI): migration panel + preview + admin opt-out for Private/Dedicated
- Releases: schedule major SDK bumps in ~3 months, communicate in advance

Marta: tagging this thread as the single source for the rollout plan. Will open a tracking doc and link it here. :thumbsup:
Jamal: LGTM.
Priya: :+1:
Leo: :rocket:
